info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Counterparty Administration Market Data API provides access to critical market data based on specified parameters. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about counterparties, facilitating informed decision-making in banking operations. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, risk managers, and developers working on financial applications. By leveraging this endpoint, users can efficiently obtain data necessary for compliance, analysis, and operational tasks relevant to counterparty management.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific counterparty using its unique identifier, enabling users to view comprehensive information associated with that counterparty.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving market data for a specific counterparty. This includes parameters such as counterparty ID and other necessary filters to fetch the corresponding market data efficiently.

GetMarketDataByParam1Request.title: Counterparty Administration Request Body
GetMarketDataByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for operations related to counterparty administration. It is expected to be a string, typically used for passing specific textual data in the request.
